tagline: Steel Dynamics is a leading U.S. manufacturer of steel products and a prominent provider of metals recycling and aluminum recycled products services.
hero_kpi_rationale: Steel Operations shipment volume is a key indicator of demand and production capacity in the company's core business, representing 72% of consolidated sales.

kpis.name: Steel Operations Segment Shipments
kpis.explanation: Total volume of steel shipped from the company's steelmaking facilities, excluding inter-segment transfers.
kpis.description: Shipments reached a record 12.3 million tons in 2025 (13.7 million including intra-segment), supported by manufacturing demand, infrastructure programs, and declining imports.
kpis.signal: Increased shipments driven by higher volumes and sustained demand.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total consolidated revenues generated from the sale of products and services after elimination of inter-segment sales.
kpis.description: Consolidated net sales reached $18.2 billion in 2025, up 4%, driven by performance in steel operations, metals recycling, and 49% growth in aluminum operations.
kpis.signal: Moderate revenue growth driven by volume increases.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Profit generated from the company's core operations before interest and taxes.
kpis.description: Operating income decreased 24% to $1.48 billion in 2025, impacted by compression in metal spreads in steel operations and lower selling prices in steel fabrication.
kpis.signal: Significant decline in operating income due to margin compression.

kpis.name: Steel Operations Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Profit from iron and steel production activities at blast furnaces and electric arc furnaces.
kpis.description: Steel Operations operating income declined 10% to $1.43 billion in 2025, despite a 9% increase in volumes, due to a 2% compression in metal spread.
kpis.signal: Decline in steel operations operating income due to narrowing spread between selling prices and scrap costs.

kpis.name: Metals Recycling Operations Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Profit from processing, marketing, and selling recycled ferrous and non-ferrous metals.
kpis.description: Metals recycling operating income increased 27% to $97.2 million in 2025, supported by a 5% rise in ferrous volumes and a 24% increase in non-ferrous metal spreads.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in metals recycling operating income driven by higher volumes and pricing.

kpis.name: Steel Fabrication Operations Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Profit from fabrication of steel products such as beams, joists, and floor decks.
kpis.description: Steel fabrication operating income decreased 39% to $407.4 million in 2025, impacted by a 13% decline in selling prices and an 8% drop in volumes, despite a strong backlog extending into the first half of 2026.
kpis.signal: Sharp decline in steel fabrication operating income due to margin compression and lower volumes.

kpis.name: Aluminum Operations Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated from the production and sale of recycled aluminum products and related services.
kpis.description: Aluminum operations net sales increased 49% to $473.9 million in 2025, driven by the launch of the recycled flat-rolled aluminum products facility in the second half of 2025, which shipped 15,000 tons of finished products.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in aluminum operations net sales with the start-up of the new facility.

kpis.short: Selling, General and Administrative Expenses as % of Net Sales
kpis.name: Selling, General and Administrative Expenses as % of Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Percentage of operating expenses (SG&A) relative to consolidated net sales.
kpis.description: SG&A expenses totaled $765.3 million in 2025 (4.2% of sales), up 15% due to construction, start-up, and commissioning costs for the new aluminum plant and satellite centers.
kpis.signal: Increase in SG&A as a percentage of net sales, linked to start-up costs.
kpis.name_en: Selling, General and Administrative Expenses as % of Net Sales

kpis.name: Income Tax Expense
kpis.explanation: Amount of income taxes paid by the company.
kpis.description: Income tax expense decreased 29% to $305.7 million in 2025, in line with lower pre-tax income, with an effective tax rate of 20.5% compared to 21.8% in 2024.
kpis.signal: Reduction in income tax expense reflecting lower pre-tax profits.

kpis.name: Steel Operations Segment Shipments
kpis.explanation: Total volume of steel shipped from the company's steelmaking facilities, excluding inter-segment transfers.
kpis.description: Shipments reached a record 12.3 million tons in 2025 (13.7 million including intra-segment), supported by manufacturing demand, infrastructure programs, and declining imports.
kpis.signal: Increased shipments driven by higher volumes and sustained demand.

kpis.name: Aluminum Operations Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated from the production and sale of recycled aluminum products and related services.
kpis.description: Aluminum operations net sales increased 49% to $473.9 million in 2025, driven by the launch of the recycled flat-rolled aluminum products facility in the second half of 2025.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in aluminum operations net sales with the start-up of the new facility.

kpis.name: Steel Fabrication Operations Order Backlog
kpis.explanation: Volume and estimated value of firm customer orders not yet delivered for structural steel fabrication.
kpis.description: Steel fabrication benefits from a robust order backlog, supported by stable demand in commercial construction, data centers, manufacturing, warehousing, and healthcare sectors.
kpis.signal: Order backlog remains strong, extending into the first half of 2026.

ai_positioning.summary: Steel Dynamics, Inc. operates in the steel manufacturing, metals recycling, and recycled aluminum products fabrication sectors. The provided text does not mention any involvement or strategy related to artificial intelligence.
